slice.objective: Audit the official gitsign online Rekor path to pin the exact byte serialization hashed for a Git commit SHA and derive the deterministic Rekor hash key for target commit 573f2f0a00718109e2cd2fc1c1c9bf2f5a0404de.
observations: Client.Write passes commitSHA directly as []byte(commitSHA) into WriteMessage without canonicalization or added delimiters.
WriteMessage computes SHA-256 over exactly those message bytes before uploading the HashedRekord.
For the exact lowercase 40-hex target string, the hashed byte sequence is the ASCII bytes of 573f2f0a00718109e2cd2fc1c1c9bf2f5a0404de, with no newline or prefix.
The deterministic SHA-256 value for that exact byte sequence is 8a3cd03dd5c7dcb78056f9bb65b5f1760a7e2b4a280256b23cd1a14146bb8f75.
slice.tested_scope: Official gitsign source at commit 6f3d985de8f41b2534010bb015ede094e2e6f9d6, pkg/rekor/rekor.go, specifically Client.Write and Client.WriteMessage plus deterministic local SHA-256 of the exact target lowercase commit-SHA string. slice.scope_guard: This establishes only gitsign's exact online hash construction for the supplied target string and the derived lookup key. It does not establish that any Rekor entry exists for the target, that a matching certificate exists, or that the target commit was actually signed with gitsign.
